questions.question: 构建一棵哈希树来组织仓库中的数据。
questions.questionEn: Build a hash tree to organise data in a repository.

questions.question: 给定一个仓库快照（路径 → 内容），构建一棵 Merkle 树，并编写函数返回两个快照之间发生变更的文件，且不比较每个文件的内容。
questions.questionEn: Given a repository snapshot (path → content), build a Merkle tree and write the function returning which files changed between two snapshots without comparing every file's content.

questions.question: 打印二叉树节点的顶视图。
questions.questionEn: Print the top view of nodes in a binary tree.

questions.question: 在文件系统中找出重复文件。
questions.questionEn: Find duplicate files in a file system.

questions.question: 实现编辑器文本缓冲区的核心：在任意位置高效地插入/删除，以及快速按行查找。你会选择什么数据结构？
questions.questionEn: Implement the core of an editor text buffer: efficient insert/delete at arbitrary positions and fast line lookup. What structure do you pick?

questions.topicName: 推理、服务与 GPU 性能
questions.question: 要把自研补全模型服务给数百万 DAU：请讲讲推理成本模型，以及你最优先的三个抓手。
questions.questionEn: Serving a custom completion model to millions of DAU: walk me through the inference-cost model and your top three levers.

questions.question: 长上下文窗口越来越便宜。为什么不干脆去掉 retrieval，把整个仓库都塞进每次请求的上下文里？
questions.questionEn: Long context windows keep getting cheaper. Why not drop retrieval and stuff the whole repo into context for every request?

sources.title: LLM 中的 lost-in-the-middle 问题

questions.question: 为一个能根据自然语言任务做多文件改动的 agent 设计 harness。如何避免它把代码库搞坏？
questions.questionEn: Design the harness for an agent that makes multi-file changes from a natural-language task. How do you keep it from wrecking a codebase?

questions.question: 设计一个能自主适应新任务的 agentic AI 系统。
questions.questionEn: Design an agentic AI system that can autonomously adapt to new tasks.

questions.question: 设计 Cursor 的 tab（下一处编辑预测）系统：对数百万日活用户来说，它必须让人感觉是即时的（感知延迟低于 100 ms）。
questions.questionEn: Design Cursor's tab (next-edit prediction) system: it must feel instant (sub-100 ms perceived latency) for millions of daily users.

questions.question: 你会如何为包含 10 万个文件的 monorepo 建立索引，让 AI 编辑器能够检索到相关上下文，并在用户编辑时保持索引更新？
questions.questionEn: How would you index a 100k-file monorepo so an AI editor can retrieve relevant context, and keep the index fresh as the user edits?

questions.question: 模型正在流式输出一次多文件编辑，而用户还在其中某个文件里继续输入。你如何在不破坏缓冲区的前提下应用这些编辑？
questions.questionEn: The model is streaming a multi-file edit while the user keeps typing in one of those files. How do you apply the edits without corrupting the buffer?

questions.question: 你的 agent 模型输出了一个 500 行文件的修改版本。逐字应用既慢又容易出错。你如何让“应用”这一步又快又可靠？
questions.questionEn: Your agent model outputs an edited version of a 500-line file. Applying it verbatim is slow and error-prone. How do you make “apply” fast and reliable?

questions.question: 一个 agent 需要在代码上反复迭代（运行构建、测试、lint），同时不干扰用户在编辑器里看到的内容。请设计这样的架构。
questions.questionEn: An agent needs to iterate on code (run builds, tests, lints) without disturbing what the user sees in their editor. Architect that.

questions.question: 在上线之前，你如何评估一个代码编辑模型？请为 tab 或 agent 编辑设计离线与在线评估方案。
questions.questionEn: How do you evaluate a code-editing model before shipping it? Design the offline and online eval story for tab or agent edits.

questions.question: 你可以在我们的代码库里待两天，且没有被分配任务。你会构建什么？又会如何安排这段时间？
questions.questionEn: You have two days in our codebase and no assigned task. What do you build, and how do you spend the time?

questions.question: 讲讲你为了长期收益而做出短期牺牲的一次经历。
questions.questionEn: Tell me about a time you made short-term sacrifices for long-term gains.
